usage: 蟲 is a noun and refers to insects in general, like ants, flies, or beetles.
It can be used to talk about living insects as well as insect-like creatures.
蟲 can be combined with other words to specify certain insects, like 蚊蟲 (mosquitoes and insects).
In Cantonese, it is common to use 蟲 in both formal and casual speech to describe bugs or pests.
蟲 is often used as a general term and not for specific insect species; for those, more specific names are used.
